index.summary: Align Skill contracts on iteration actions, lifecycle statuses, and transaction visibility semantics.

task.title: Align Skill contracts on iteration actions, lifecycle statuses, and transaction visibility semantics
task.objective: Update skills/dogdouspec/references/authority.md and mutations.md to precisely reflect all ConfirmationActionType actions, IterationStatusType replanning, and honest multi-document transaction visibility.
task.rationale: Ensures AI paired agents have exact understanding of owner confirmation actions and low-level transaction isolation guarantees.

acceptance.criterion: Iteration lifecycle dispositions include 'replanning' and owner authority documentation covers all confirmation actions (activate, accept-design-change, continue, replan, complete, cancel, supersede).
Transaction documentation accurately reflects writer project locking, sequential per-file atomic replacements, unlocked reader visibility during publish, and startup crash recovery convergence.

context.summary: Aligning authority.md and mutations.md on full confirmation actions, replanning lifecycle status, and honest multi-document transaction visibility semantics.

record.summary: Started Skill contract convergence task.

Confirmed Skill contract discrepancies to resolve: (1) authority.md omitted 'replanning' from IterationStatusType and omitted owner confirmation actions (accept-design-change, continue, replan), while requirement row phrased owner action as merely approval rather than explicit owner disposition; (2) mutations.md described transaction apply in a way that could imply simultaneous multi-file filesystem visibility, whereas V1_CLI_CONTRACT.md section 11 establishes that writers use one project lock, each file replacement is an atomic whole-file replacement, unlocked readers may temporarily observe mixed old/new revisions during multi-file publish, and startup crash recovery before the next write converges to a single valid set.

Verified Skill contract convergence fixes: (1) authority.md updated with full ConfirmationActionType actions (activate, accept-design-change, continue, replan, complete, cancel, supersede), IterationStatusType replanning, and explicit owner disposition wording; (2) mutations.md updated to honestly describe writer project locking, individual whole-file atomic replacements, unlocked reader visibility during publish, and startup crash recovery convergence matching V1_CLI_CONTRACT.md section 11; (3) quick_validate.py passed; (4) build.cmd passed 541 tests (396 Core + 145 CLI); (5) workspace validation passed.
Completed Skill contract convergence task. Both criteria verified and confirmed across all contract references.
